newsitem.title: USA: Liz Taylor's estranged husband arrested.
newsitem.headline: Liz Taylor's estranged husband arrested.

text.p: Larry Fortensky, the estranged husband of movie star Elizabeth Taylor, was arrested and charged with traffic violations and possession of a loaded handgun, police said on Monday.

Police in Redondo Beach, on the Pacific coast south of Los Angeles, said Fortensky, 44, was released following his arrest on Sunday afternoon and must appear in South Bay Municipal Court in Torrance on Oct. 7.

Fortensky was stopped for driving a motorcycle without a helmet, police said. Officers then allegedly discovered the motorcycle was not registered, his license had expired and that he was in possession of a loaded handgun, they said.

Fortensky, a construction worker who married Taylor in 1991, also was arrested in August for drug use after police found him in an illegally parked luxury motor home in Hemet, about 70 miles (110 km) east of Los Angeles. He was scheduled to appear for arraignment on that drug charge on Friday.
Taylor and Fortensky met in 1990 at the Betty Ford Clinic in Palm Springs, California, where she was being treated for dependency on prescription drugs and he was undergoing treatment for alcoholism.
At the time of their marriage, which was Taylor's eighth, she was 59 and he was 39.
Taylor filed for divorce in February this year and the divorce proceedings are still going through the courts.
